name: hazel_weir_central_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Central Procedural Graph featuring active cyclical peak arbitrage, full Day 30 Town Shop fulfillment, decoupled low-hurdle 10-hand workforce scaling, inverted plot expansion, purged zero-animal feed locks, and maturation-horizon seed purchasing.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Preemptively matches unlocked town shop demand surges and immediately fulfills mature high-margin crops (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins, Strawberries) to capture 2.0x-3.5x contract price premiums through Day 30.

nodes.name: Shed Headroom Relief
nodes.description: Prevents silent 100/100 harvest discards by clearing uncommitted low-margin inventory under dynamic tiered price floors while protecting animal feed and shop contracts.

nodes.name: Market Peak Arbitrage & Oracle Front-Run
nodes.description: Monitors spot prices and 96-step TTM forecast to routinely liquidate surplus shed inventory during cyclical price peaks (>= 1.05x base price) while preemptively dumping vulnerable commodities before opponent market gluts.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash beyond wage reserves into accelerated workforce scaling (10-hand sprint), contiguous land expansion, and maturation-horizon commercial seed procurement.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes localized field routines with strict operational sequencing: direct shed harvest drop-offs, contiguous cluster harvesting, crop watering, seed planting, and ground maintenance.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases (BUY_SEED, BUY_ANIMAL, BUY_LAND, BUY_FERTILIZER, redundant HIRE); direct hands carrying harvested produce to deposit at shed before hour 21; enforce emergency batch liquidation of uncommitted, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3; exactly zero when holding no livestock); do not rely on low-margin fertilizer sales to cover payroll deficits; never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery unless facing unavoidable midnight bankruptcy.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and ((net_available_cash >= 120.0 and day <= 26) or shop_deliverable_inventory > 0) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Allocate up to 3 market slots to immediately deliver matching mature shed inventory directly to town shops to capture 2.0x-3.5x contract price premiums through Day 30; procure shop-demanded seeds (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins) on Days 1-26 when available cash covers seed costs plus midnight wage reserves.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not commit seed capital if net cash falls below 1.20x midnight payroll reserve; halt shop seed purchasing after Day 26 to eliminate stranded unharvested crops; never sell contracted shop produce to the general market at standard rates.

attributes.guidance: Evict non-urgent pending orders to free market execution slots; execute batch sales of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings with price >= 0.75 * base_price; only relax floor to 0.50 * base_price if shed_used >= 94 to prevent silent harvest discard drops.
attributes.pitfalls: Never fire-sell at sub-0.50 base price during transient shed spikes; never liquidate Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3; zero when holding no livestock); never evict produce committed to active town shop fulfillment.

attributes.condition: (current_price >= 1.05 * base_price and unreserved_shed_inventory > 0) or (oracle_glut_risk >= 0.25 and current_price >= 0.75 * base_price) or (day >= 29 and hour >= 18 and unreserved_shed_inventory > 0)
attributes.guidance: Execute proactive high-margin batch liquidations of unreserved shed commodities whenever spot prices reach cyclical peaks (>= 1.05 * base_price); front-run anticipated gluts by liquidating vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry, Pumpkin) while prices remain >= 0.75 * base_price; on Days 29-30, progressively clear all non-contract inventory to convert assets to cash before game close.
attributes.pitfalls: Never liquidate produce allocated for active town shop fulfillment (2.0x-3.5x premium); never liquidate Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3); do not sell into collapsed sub-0.50x base price markets unless terminal step (step >= 716) requires absolute cash conversion.

attributes.condition: ((hired_hands < 10 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.15 + 75.0) or (uncultivated_plots <= 1 and total_plots < 26 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.25 + 150.0) or (net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.20 + 60.0 and has_seed_deficit)) and day <= 28
attributes.guidance: Rapidly scale workforce to the 10-hand cap by Day 4-5 using a lowered wage buffer ($75 buffer); expand contiguous farm acreage when existing plots are fully cultivated (uncultivated_plots <= 1) up to 24-26 plots; halt workforce and land expansion after Day 24; align commercial seed purchases with crop maturation cycles: halt Pumpkin seed purchases after Day 26, Tomato seeds after Day 27, and Carrot seeds after Day 28, transitioning to ultra-fast Wheat through Day 29; strictly prohibit fertilizer purchases until 10 hands and 20 plots are fully established.
attributes.pitfalls: Never purchase land if uncultivated plots exceed 1; never buy fertilizer before workforce is capped at 10 hands; never allocate reinvestment cash if remaining balance drops below 1.15x midnight wage reserve; do not purchase long-growth seeds past their maturation cutoff windows.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch active hands with strict localized task routing: 1) If carrying harvested inventory, navigate directly to shed to deposit produce without wandering; 2) Harvest mature crops on contiguous plot clusters; 3) Water dry planted crops to maintain uninterrupted growth cycles; 4) Plant commercial high-margin seeds on tilled plots; 5) Feed livestock only if animals exist and feed is available; 6) Weed clearing and ground tilling on idle plots. Ensure all workers deposit any carried inventory at the shed before step 716 for terminal liquidation.
attributes.pitfalls: Never defer inventory drop-offs past immediate shed transit; never allow hands to carry harvested produce while adjacent unwatered or harvestable crops stall; do not prioritize weeding or ground tilling over harvesting or watering; never purchase feed or assign livestock feeding when holding zero animals.
